 Speaker’s Card/Request to Speak: If you would like to address the City Council on a scheduled agenda
 item, please complete the Request to Speak Form. The card is at the table at the entrance to the Council
 Chamber. Please identify on the card your name, address, and the item on which you would like to speak
 and return to the City Clerk. The Request to Speak Form assists the Mayor in ensuring that all persons
 wishing to address the Council are recognized. Your name will be called at the time the matter is heard
 by the Council.

  2.1  Proclaim the week of May 11-17, 2008 as "National Police Week."

INTRODUCTIONS

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

ANNOUNCEMENTS/COMMITTEE REPORTS/COUNCIL REPORTS

  Announcements, Committee Reports and Council Comments are for the purpose of presenting
  brief comments or reports, are subject to California Government Code Section 54954.2 of the
  Brown Act and are limited to 15 minutes per meeting.

ADDITIONS AND DELETIONS

  Additions to the agenda are limited by California Government Code Section 54954.2 of the
  Brown Act and for those items that arise after the posting of the Agenda and must be acted upon
  prior to the next City Council meeting.

3.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and enacted by one roll
  call vote. There will be no discussion of these items unless members of the City Council request
  specific items to be removed from the Consent Calendar for separate discussion. Any member of
  the public may address the Council on items on the Consent Calendar. Public comments on any
  item or items on the consent calendar are limited to three minutes per speaker. If you wish to
  speak to a particular item or items, please complete a Speakers Form and give it to the City
  Clerk.

  3.1  MINUTES

  ACTION:  Approve the minutes of a regular meeting of the City
  Council held on April 8, 2008.

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  2
 City Council Agenda  April 22, 2008

  3.2  PROCLAMATIONS

  ACTION:
  1)  Proclaim the month of May 2008 as "Cure Children's Cancer
  Month."
  2)  Proclaim the week of May 4-10, 2008 as "California Building Safety
  Week."
  3)  Proclaim the month of May 2008 as "ALS Awareness Month."
  4)  Proclaim the week of May 4-10, 2008 as "Municipal Clerks Week."
  5)  Commend State Street Investment Manager Solutions as "2007
  Business of the Year."

  3.3  WARRANT AND WIRE TRANSFER RESOLUTION

  ACTION:  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ALLOWING CERTAIN
  CLAIMS AND DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT
  OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID

  3.4  WARRANT AND WIRE TRANSFER RESOLUTION - AT&T

  ACTION:  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ALLOWING CERTAIN
  CLAIMS AND DEMANDS OF AT&T AND SPECIFYING THE
  FUNDS OUT OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID

  3.5  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENTS STATUS REPORT

  ACTION:  Receive and file.

  3.6  ANNUAL LOCAL STREET REHABILITATION AND SLURRY SEAL
  PROJECTS - CIP 318140 AND 318200

  ACTION:  Approve the specifications and contract documents
  for the Fiscal Year 2007-08 Local Street Rehabilitation and Slurry
  Seal Projects, Capital Improvement Project (CIP) 318140 and CIP
  318200, on file with the Public Works Department.

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  3
 City Council Agenda  April 22, 2008

  3.7  RESOLUTION ACCEPTING COUNTY GRANT FUNDS FOR MEDICAL
  SHARPS WASTE DIVERSION PROJECT

  ACTION:
  1)  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE ACCEPTING GRANT FUNDS
  FROM THE COUNTY OF ORANGE TO IMPLEMENT A MEDICAL
  SHARPS WASTE DIVERSION PROJECT
  2)  Approve a Budget Adjustment increasing grant revenues and
  related appropriations by $40,000 for acceptance of County grant
  funding.

  3.8  OFFICE OF TRAFFIC SAFETY SEAT BELT ENFORCEMENT GRANT

  ACTION:
  1)  Accept an Office of Traffic Safety seat belt enforcement grant
  award, "Click it or Ticket," in the amount of $16,000.
  2)  Approve a budget adjustment request form in the amount of
  $16,000, reflecting $16,000 in revenues and appropriations.

  3.9  AGREEMENT TO TRANSFER PROPERTY OR FUNDS FOR 2007
  HOMELAND SECURITY GRANT PROGRAM PURPOSES

  ACTION:
  1)  Authorize the Director of Public Safety to accept the Agreement to
  Transfer Property or Funds for 2007 Homeland Security Grant
  Program Purposes.
  2)  Approve a budget adjustment request form in the amount of
  $175,000 in grant revenues and appropriations for training and
  equipment.
  3)  Authorize the Director of Public Safety to submit for reimbursement
  up to $50,000 in training and $125,000 in approved equipment
  through the FY07 Homeland Security Grant Program.

  3.10  CALIFORNIA HIGHWAY PATROL GRANT FOR THE EVERY 15
  MINUTES PROGRAM

  ACTION:
  1)  Accept a California Highway Patrol grant award in the amount of
  $9,999.99.
  2)  Approve a budget adjustment request form in the amount of
  $9,999.99, reflecting $9,999.99 in revenues and appropriations.

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  4
 City Council Agenda  April 22, 2008

  3.11  VACATION OF A PORTION OF CRESTED BIRD, WOODBURY
  (PLANNING AREA 9)

  ACTION:  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE TO ORDER THE
  VACATION OF A PORTION OF CRESTED BIRD WITHIN
  WOODBURY (PLANNING AREA 9) PURSUANT TO CHAPTER 4,
  SUMMARY VACATION, STREETS AND HIGHWAYS CODE
  SECTION 8330 ET. SEQ.

  3.12  ALLOCATION AND DISPOSITION OF UNALLOCATED YEAR-END
  SURPLUS

  ACTION:
  1)  Allocate $250,000 from the Unallocated Year End Surplus and
  establish a CIP project to provide emergency repairs to a City
  owned storm water retaining berm at the northwest intersection of
  the 405 Freeway and Sand Canyon.
  2)  Approve the attached Budget Adjustment transferring $2,200,000
  from the Unallocated Year-End Surplus to the Contingency Fund.

  3.13  APPROVAL OF NEW WATER QUALITY ORDINANCE
  IMPLEMENTATION AGREEMENT WITH THE ORANGE COUNTY
  FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT

  ACTION:
  1)  Approve the new agreement with the Orange County Flood Control
  District naming Orange County Flood Control District as an enforcer
  of the Water Quality Ordinance, authorize the Mayor to execute,
  and City Clerk to attest and approve as to form by the City Attorney.
  2)  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE NAMING THE ORANGE
  COUNTY FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT AS AN ENFORCER OF
  THE WATER QUALITY ORDINANCE
END CONSENT CALENDAR

4.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  Public Hearings are scheduled for a time certain of 4:00 p.m., unless noticed otherwise, or as
  soon thereafter as possible. Those wishing to address the City Council during the Public
  Hearing must complete a form and provide it to the City Clerk prior to the hearing.
  Notice: Public Hearings listed for continuance will be continued as noted and posting of this
  agenda serves as notice of continuation. Any matter not noted for continuance, will be posted

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  5
 City Council Agenda  April 22, 2008

  separately.

  4.1  APPROVAL OF THE ANNUAL ACTION PLAN FOR FISCAL YEAR
  2008-09 AS THE APPLICATION AND STATEMENT OF PROJECTED
  USE OF FUNDS FOR THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND
  URBAN DEVELOPMENT (HUD) COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK
  GRANT (CDBG), HOME INVESTMENT PARTNERSHIP PROGRAM
  (HOME) AND AMERICAN DREAM DOWN PAYMENT INITIATIVE
  (ADDI) ALLOCATIONS

  ACTION:
  1)  Open the public hearing; receive public input; City Council
  comments and questions.
  2)  Close the public hearing.
  3)  Approve funding recommendations for Fiscal Year 2008-09 CDBG,
  HOME, and ADDI funds.
  4)  Authorize the City Manager to execute the submitted Annual Action
  Plan and all documents deemed necessary by HUD to obtain the
  allocation of federal CDBG, HOME, and ADDI funds, including
  agreements implementing the funding recommendations.
  5)  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE APPROVING THE ANNUAL
  ACTION PLAN WHICH IS PART OF THE CONSOLIDATED PLAN,
  AND THE PROJECTED USE OF COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
  BLOCK GRANT (CDBG), HOME INVESTMENT PARTNERSHIP
  PROGRAM (HOME), AND AMERICAN DREAM DOWN PAYMENT
  INITIATIVE (ADDI) FUNDS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2008-09

  4.2  GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT, ZONE CHANGE AND DEVELOPMENT
  AGREEMENT FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF 176 APARTMENT UNITS
  AT 2802 KELVIN AVENUE IN PLANNING AREA 36

  ACTION:
  1)  Open the public hearing; receive public input; City Council
  comments and questions.
  2)  Close the public hearing.
  3)  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE CERTIFYING
  ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT (SCH #2007021007) FOR
  2802 KELVIN AVENUE INCLUDING REQUIRED FINDINGS OF
  FACTS AND ADOPTING A MITIGATION MONITORING AND
  REPORTING PROGRAM PURSUANT TO THE CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA) AND THE CEQA
  GUIDELINES

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  6
 City Council Agenda  April 22, 2008

  4)  Adopt RESOLUTION NO. - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF IRVINE APPROVING GENERAL
  PLAN AMENDMENT 00419336-PGA TO AMEND LAND USE
  TABLE A-1 OF THE GENERAL PLAN TO ALLOW
  DEVELOPMENT OF A MAXIMUM OF 176 APARTMENTS AT
  2802 KELVIN AVENUE, LOCATED AT THE SOUTHEAST
  CORNER OF JAMBOREE ROAD AND KELVIN AVENUE;
  PLANNING AREA 36; FILED BY IRVINE APARTMENT
  COMMUNITIES
  5)  Introduce for first reading and read by title only ORDINANCE NO. -
  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  IRVINE APPROVING ZONE CHANGE 00419337-PZC TO
  CHANGE THE ZONING ON LOT 9 OF TRACT 7905 FROM 5.1
  IBC MULTI-USE TO 5.3C IBC RESIDENTIAL FOR 2802 KELVIN
  AVENUE, LOCATED AT THE SOUTHEAST CORNER OF
  JAMBOREE ROAD AND KELVIN AVENUE; PLANNING AREA 36;
  FILED BY IRVINE APARTMENT COMMUNITIES
  6)  Introduce for first reading and read by title only ORDINANCE NO. -
  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  IRVINE APPROVING AN IRVINE BUSINESS COMPLEX
  AREAWIDE DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT 00460099-PDA FOR
  THE DEVELOPMENT OF A MAXIMUM OF 176 APARTMENT
  UNITS AT 2802 KELVIN AVENUE, LOCATED ON THE
  SOUTHEAST CORNER OF JAMBOREE ROAD AND KELVIN
  AVENUE IN PLANNING AREA 36; FILED BY IRVINE
  APARTMENT COMMUNITIES

5.  COUNCIL BUSINESS

  5.1  APPOINTMENT OF REPRESENTATIVE FOR DISTRICT 14 FOR
  SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF GOVERNMENTS (SCAG)

  ACTION:
  1)  Appoint City Council representative to SCAG Regional Council and
  Orange County Council of Governments (OCCOG) Board of
  Directors.
  2)  Appoint City Council alternate to OCCOG Board of Directors.

  5.2  SENIOR FACILITIES IN NORTHERN IRVINE AND IMPLEMENTATION
  OF THE NORTHERN SPHERE COMMUNITY PARK DESIGN PROCESS

  ACTION:
  1)  Approve the concept plan for senior facilities in northern Irvine.

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  7
 City Council Agenda  April 22, 2008

  2)  Direct staff to implement the park design process with The Irvine
  Company in accordance with the northern Sphere Community Park
  Amenity Program.

  5.3  LIBRARY SERVICES ADVISORY COMMITTEE RECOMMENDATIONS

  ACTION:
  1)  Adopt a library space ratio of .86 square feet per capita and request
  that the City Council amend the City's General Plan.
  2)  Approve in concept three new neighborhood libraries with a
  combined square footage of 70,000 as a priority and allocate the
  balance of the square footage to the metropolitan library at the
  Orange County Great Park.
  3)  Authorize staff to explore land acquisition opportunities.
  4)  Take the necessary steps to adopt a new library parking standard
  of 1 space per 300 square feet.
  5)  Approve the Library Services Advisory Committee's short-, mid-,
  and long-term goals.

  5.4  HERITAGE FIELDS DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT COMPLIANCE
  AND PROJECT STATUS REPORT

  ACTION:  Receive and file.
END COUNCIL BUSINESS

PUBLIC COMMENTS (Limited to 3 minutes per speaker) - 6:30 P.M.

ADJOURNMENT

Next Meeting: CITY COUNCIL REGULAR meeting, May 13, 2008, 4:00 p.m., City of
Irvine, City Council Chamber, One Civic Center Plaza, Irvine, California.

  NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC
  LIVE BROADCASTING
  nd  th
City Council meetings are broadcasted live every 2 and 4 Tuesday of the month at 4:00 p.m. and are
replayed on Sundays at 11:00 a.m., and Thursdays at 7:00 p.m. All broadcasts can be viewed on Cox
Communications Local Access Channel 30. City Council meetings are also available via live webcast
through the City’s website at www.cityofirvine.org. For more information, please contact the City Clerk’s
office at (949)724-6205.
  ADJOURNMENT
At 11:00 p.m., the City Council will determine which of the remaining agenda items can be considered
and acted upon prior to 12:00 midnight and will continue all other items on which additional time is
required until a future City Council meeting. All meetings are scheduled to terminate at 12:00 midnight.
  STAFF REPORTS

Prepared by the City Clerk’s Office  8
 City Council Agenda  April 22, 2008

As a general rule, staff reports or other written documentation have been prepared or organized with
respect to each item of business listed on the agenda. Copies of these materials are on file with the City
Clerk and are available for public inspection and copying. Staff reports can also be downloaded from the
City’s website at http://www.ci.irvine.ca.us/council/agenda/agenda_archive.asp beginning the Friday prior
to the scheduled City Council meeting on Tuesday.

In addition, meetings can be viewed live at the time posted on the agenda and related staff reports can be
opened and viewed simultaneously along with the streaming of the meeting. To view the meeting, go to
http://irvine.granicus.com/ViewPublisher.php?view_id=6.
If you have any questions regarding any item of business on the agenda for this meeting, or any of the
staff reports or other documentation relating to any agenda item, please contact City Clerk staff at
(949)724-6205.
  CITY SERVICES TO FACILITATE ACCESS TO PUBLIC MEETINGS
It is the intention of the City of Irvine to comply with the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA) in all
respects. If, as an attendee or a participant at this meeting, you will need special assistance beyond what
is normally provided, the City of Irvine will attempt to accommodate you in every reasonable manner.
Please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (949)724-6205.

Assisted listening devices are available at the meeting for individuals with hearing impairments.
Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure
accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35. 102-35. 104 ADA Title II)
  CHALLENGING CITY DECISIONS
The time limit within which to commence any lawsuit or legal challenge to any quasi-adjudicative decision
made by the City is governed by Section 1094.6 of the Code of Civil Procedure, unless a shorter
limitations period is specified by any other provision. Under Section 1094.6, any lawsuit or legal challenge
  th
to any quasi-adjudicative decision made by the City must be filed no later than the 90 day following the
date on which such decision becomes final. Any lawsuit or legal challenge, which is not filed within that
90-day period, will be barred.

If a person wishes to challenge the nature of the above actions in court, they may be limited to raising
only those issues they or someone else raised at the meeting described in this notice, or in written
correspondence delivered to the City of Irvine, at or prior to the meeting. In addition, judicial challenge
may be limited or barred where the interested party has not sought and exhausted all available
administrative remedies.
  COMMUNICATION DEVICES
To minimize distractions, please be sure all personal communication devices are turned off or on silent
mode.
  MEETING SCHEDULE
Regular meetings of the City Council are held on the second and fourth Tuesdays of each month at 4:00
p.m. Study Sessions and/or Closed Sessions are periodically held prior to the start of the regular meeting.
